title: Software Engineer II (DevX team)
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY

At OpenGov bold ideas ship daily and rapid iteration turns directly into measurable customer impact. We stay relentlessly aligned with customer outcomes while pushing the frontier of AI-driven software development, using cutting-edge AI tools and techniques to build systems that scale.

As a  Software Engineer II  at OpenGov, you’ll build best-in-class SaaS solutions that enable efficiency, transparency, and accountability within government agencies. As a crucial member of our engineering team, you’ll lead and deliver new features and improvements in a fast-paced, agile environment, utilizing modern technologies such as ReactJS, Typescript, GraphQL, and NodeJS in an AI first engineering culture.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Collaborate across the organization to understand and translate business priorities into shipped features delivering customer success.

 - Generate clean, efficient, and well-documented software following industry best practices.

 - Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members for both Human and AI generated code.

 - Develop, test, and deploy high-quality software with minimum supervision

 - Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical issues.

 - Contribute to  continuous improvement and operational excellence

 - Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends to drive innovation within the team

 - Contribute to OpenGov’s Engineering culture of innovation, leading-edge technology adoption and quality




REQUIREMENTS AND PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth, ambiguous environment

 - Experience gathering and incorporating feedback from users, teammates, or stakeholders to improve the quality and usability of products or projects.

 - Experience working across the stack (frontend + backend) and comfort shipping features end-to-end

 - Experience building with AI-driven UX, agents, and workflow automation (direct ML experience not required)

 - BA/BS in a computer-science-related discipline or equivalent experience required

 - Demonstrate a strong understanding of data structure, algorithms




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Full Stack Developer (Desktop Engineering)
description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a valuesdriven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.

Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Engineer (React, Python & AWS) to design, develop, and support modern cloud-native applications that deliver seamless digital experiences and scalable backend services. This role combines frontend development, backend engineering, cloud architecture, and DevOps practices to build secure, high-performing, and user-centric applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in React, hands-on experience with Python-based backend development, and deep familiarity with AWS cloud services. You will work across the full software development lifecycle, collaborating with cross-functional teams to build responsive web applications, scalable APIs, cloud-native solutions, and automated deployment pipelines.
Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain responsive, user-friendly, and high-performance web applications using React and modern frontend development practices.
- Build and enhance backend services, REST APIs, and microservices using Python and related frameworks.
- Integrate frontend applications with backend systems, third-party services, and enterprise platforms to enable seamless business workflows.
- Implement secure authentication, authorization, and application security best practices across frontend and backend components.
- Deploy, manage, and optimize cloud-native applications using AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, EC2, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFront, and IAM.
- Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar tools to support automated testing and deployments.
- Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize application performance using CloudWatch, logging frameworks, and observability tools.
- Collaborate with product, architecture, DevOps, and engineering teams to deliver scalable, maintainable, and high-quality end-to-end solutions.

- 6+ years of experience in Full Stack Development.
- 5+ of experience building responsive, scalable web applications using React, JavaScript/TypeScript.
- 2+ years of experience developing backend services, REST APIs, and integrations using Python.
- Strong experience with AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, IAM, DynamoDB, CloudFront, VPC, and CloudFormation.
- Experience integrating third-party APIs/SDKs with knowledge of telephony concepts and SIP trunking.
- Proficiency with AWS SDKs
- Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code using GitHub Actions or similar technologies.
- Experience with AIDLC like Claude or Codex.
- Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, application security, cloud-native architectures, and software development best practices.
Nice to Have
- Experience with Amazon Connect integrations, including API usage, contact flow design, routing, queues, and call-flow troubleshooting.
- Experience with troubleshooting, analytics, monitoring, and observability tools such as CloudWatch.
- Experience or knowledge of using AI and LLM models.
- Basic proficiency in backend development (Node.js, Java, or C#).
- AWS Certifications (Cloud Practitioner, Developer Associate, Solutions Architect Associate).
- Experience with event-driven architectures (SNS, SQS, EventBridge)
We offer:
- Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth. 
- Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program. 
- Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work. 
- Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities. 
- Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries. 
- Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events. 
- Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality. 
* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Senior Application Software Engineer
description:
Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the application software development lifecycle. Utilizes working knowledge to develop new application features and enhancements following design specifications, and develops documents to clarify application design and code. Leads code reviews in designated application areas to help drive improvements. Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex application issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality, integration, and service-to-service interactions. Designs and develops application software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined application architecture. Collaborates within and beyond the immediate team to understand customer use cases and align application solutions. May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding application-related issues, independently. Collaborates with the team to establish and follow application development practices, secure coding standards, and code quality. Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for application systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).

Key Responsibilities
Application Software Development:
- Drives medium features and quality improvements with measurable performance and reliability outcomes.

- Provides global production support for critical issues with minimal guidance; improves playbooks/alerts.

- Troubleshoots and debugs non-routine issues spanning application layers and common OCI services; proposes fixes.

- Partners with QA to define test strategy (unit/integration) for features; ensures consistency across modules.

- Considers trade-offs in existing architecture; proposes moderate design improvements.

- Translates ambiguous requirements into scalable designs and implementation plans.

- Defines and stabilizes API contracts and dependencies for the application area.

- Recommends build priorities within the team using data from incidents, telemetry, and customer feedback.

- Systematically incorporates external feedback (forums, live-site reports) into backlog refinement.

- Mentors junior engineers; coordinates cross-functionally on feature delivery.

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:
- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently.

- Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle.

- Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code.

- Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements.

- Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues.

- Develops fixes for identified issues.

- Implements software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process.

- Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding.

- Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.

- Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:
- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture.

- Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices.

- Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture.

- Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:
- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions.

- May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently.

- Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.

- Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.

- Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently.

- Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements).

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:
- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards.

- Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development.

- Keeps up-to-date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes.

- Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:
- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).

- Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:
- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements.

- Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency.

Collaboration & Partnership:
- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives.

- Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships.

- Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.

Problem Solving:
- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate.

- Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors.

- Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices.

Continuous Learning:
- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices.

- Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills.

- Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members.

Continuous Improvement:
- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team.

- Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the application software development lifecycle.

title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer

Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Senior Director, Engineering in the IAM department. Identity has become the new security perimeter, and in this role, you will develop workflows and application integrations in collaboration with the broader IAM team, Product Management, and Business teams. You will be responsible for the design and development of enterprise-grade Identity Management Products for Zscaler, helping organizations worldwide harness speed and agility with a cloud-first strategy.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

- Design and develop enterprise-grade Identity Management Products for Zscaler

- Participate in the design and implementation of core product functionality and key technical initiatives

- Mentor junior engineers with software development best practices

- Help maintain our positive culture as a collaborative and supportive teammate

- Collaborate across teams to deliver projects from inception to production

- You thrive in ambiguity. You are comfortable building the path as you walk it, viewing dynamic environments as opportunities to construct meaningful solutions.

- You act like an owner. You operate with a strong sense of ownership, bringing passion for the mission, high integrity, and the capability to navigate between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

- You are a proactive problem-solver. You run toward challenges and remain laser-focused on finding solutions that deliver high-impact outcomes.

- You build high-trust collaboration. You prioritize team success, welcome feedback, and practice clear, respectful candor to establish strong partnerships.

- You maintain a continuous growth mindset. You actively seek feedback and development opportunities to grow as a partner, teammate, and purpose-driven leader.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

- 8+ years of hands-on experience in application architecture and development

- Expert-level technical knowledge of Enterprise Java, OOP, OOA, systems architecture, RESTful APIs, and related frameworks such as Hibernate and Spring

- Strong knowledge of Identity and Access Management protocols, specifically SAML, OAuth, and OpenID Connect

- Experience developing enterprise-grade Security or Networking products

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

- Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency

- Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and container infrastructure

- Experience with Java reactive programming

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Strength in Trust 

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge 

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer with a passion for solving problems to join our agile Product Engineering team at OneTrust. Senior Software Engineers own the delivery of complex features end-to-end and are a go-to technical resource for their immediate team. 

Your Mission 

Execution & Delivery 

- 
Independently own delivery of complex features or components from design through production, requiring evaluation of multiple interacting factors. 

- 
Drive system architecture and component-design discussions for your area of ownership. 

Collaboration & Influence 

- 
Partner closely with Product, UX, and other engineers to shape solutions during planning, not just execution. 

- 
Network with senior engineers across the org to align on shared technical decisions. 

- 
Stays curious and has the ability to ideate, innovate & improve by identifying patterns that can bring quality and velocity improvements 

Quality & Craft 

- 
Conduct peer code reviews and help set the quality bar for your team. 

- 
Champion testing practices, including exploratory and AI-assisted testing approaches. 

Mentorship 

- 
Support the ramp-up and growth of Associate and Software Engineers on your team. 

You Are 

A seasoned, fully-capable engineer who requires minimal day-to-day direction and only needs general guidance on genuinely new assignments. You proactively surface risks and ambiguity rather than waiting to be asked. You work independently on established types of work, taking ownership from design through delivery with limited need for oversight. You're not afraid to ask for input mainly when facing unfamiliar or ambiguous problems, where the right approach isn't yet obvious. Your passionate about flagging risks and open questions during planning or design, before they turn into issues later in the process 

Your Experience Includes 

- 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field 

- 
8+ years of professional software engineering experience on Core Java, Spring, Spring boot, hibernate, microservices and Kafka messaging. Also looking at experience working on agentic platforms like Microsoft foundry, agent core, google vertex, Bedrock.

- 
Demonstrated experience owning complex features end-to-end in either frontend or backend systems 

- 
Familiarity with a public cloud provider (Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS) 

- 
Experience informally mentoring or supporting the growth of junior engineers is a plus 

- 
Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Devin, Windsurf, or similar) in a professional setting, with genuine enthusiasm for applying AI to accelerate and elevate day-to-day engineering work. 

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources 

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube

- @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.

Our Commitment to You 

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. 

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

The mission of the Amazon Offers Experience organization is to be the world’s first and most trusted choice for every customer on earth to discover and evaluate any product or service.

Our team blends machine learning models to rank and select the best offer from the most trusted merchant for all products sold on Amazon along with a world-class front-end user experience for offer comparison to our global customers. We are responsible for the experiences and services that enable developers, including our own, to create tailored shopping experiences for every customer, product, business and marketplace offered by Amazon. Buy with Amazon (BwA) brings the trust and convenience of Amazon to merchants' own websites. Shoppers on a merchant's direct-to-consumer (D2C) site can sign in with their Amazon account and use their saved addresses. title: Software Development Engineer - II
description:
About GoKwik

GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, powering merchants across checkout optimisation, RTO reduction, payments, retention, and post-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik enables 15,000+ merchants globally, processes ~$2 billion in GMV, and is rapidly scaling across India, the UK, Europe, and the US. Backed by RTP Global, Z47, Peak XV, and Think Investments, GoKwik has raised $68 million in funding, including a $13 million growth round in June 2025, and is building AI-powered infrastructure to shape the future of eCommerce.

Why This Role Matters

As a Software Development Engineer - II, you'll build and scale the backend systems that power GoKwik's checkout, payments, and post-purchase products. You'll own services end-to-end, make architectural decisions that improve platform reliability and performance, and mentor engineers while driving complex technical initiatives. The systems you build directly influence merchant conversions, customer experience, and platform scalability.

What You'll Own

- Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and NestJS, with Go for selected services.
- Build and optimize distributed systems using PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and Kafka.
- Own event-driven architectures, ensuring high throughput, reliability, fault tolerance, and scalability.
- Drive architectural decisions, document technical trade-offs, and improve system design across services.
- Deliver end-to-end features, contributing to frontend development in React or Svelte where required.
- Strengthen CI/CD pipelines, observability, monitoring, and cloud infrastructure on AWS.
- Debug production issues, improve system performance, and ensure high service reliability.
- Review code, mentor Associate Engineers and SDE I engineers, and elevate engineering standards across the team.
- Take ownership of ambiguous technical problems and independently drive them from design through production deployment.

Who You Are

- Strong backend engineering experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and NestJS.
- Working knowledge of Go or the willingness to learn and build production services with it.
- Strong understanding of PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and distributed data systems.
- Experience designing and scaling event-driven architectures using Kafka or similar messaging systems.
- Comfortable working across the stack, including frontend technologies such as React or Svelte.
- Strong understanding of scalability, reliability, maintainability, and software architecture principles.
- Experience mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and driving engineering best practices.
- Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Why GoKwik

At GoKwik, you'll solve engineering challenges at massive scale while building products that power thousands of merchants and millions of shoppers. You'll work alongside exceptional engineers, influence technical direction, mentor growing teams, and own systems that have a direct business impact. If you're looking for autonomy, technical depth, and the opportunity to build category-defining products, GoKwik is the place to do it.

title: Back End Developer
description:
Job Description: Backend Engineer

Tech Stack: NestJS | Node.js | TypeScript | Prisma ORM | PostgreSQL | Redis | Microsoft Azure | Docker

Total Exp : 6 - 8 Years
Notice Period : Immediate Joiners
Work Timings : 06.00 P.M. to 03.00 A.M

Role Overview
We are looking for a Backend Engineer with strong experience in NestJS, Node.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL to build scalable, secure, and high-performance backend systems. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of backend architecture, API design, database optimization, caching, asynchronous processing, cloud services, and production reliability.
Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and REST APIs using NestJS, Node.js, and TypeScript.
- Build modular backend architectures using NestJS modules, controllers, services, dependency injection, guards, interceptors, and middleware.
- Design and optimize database schemas, queries, relationships, indexes, and transactions using PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM.
- Implement request validation, centralized error handling, consistent API responses, and API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI.
- Develop secure authentication and authorization mechanisms, including JWT, RBAC, and permission-based access control.
- Implement caching strategies using Redis and asynchronous processing using messaging queues and background jobs.
- Integrate third-party APIs and external systems, handling authentication, rate limits, retries, timeouts, and failures.
- Optimize API performance, database access, resource utilization, and application scalability.
- Containerize applications using Docker and deploy backend services using Microsoft Azure.
- Implement structured logging, monitoring, distributed tracing, health checks, and other observability practices.
- Write automated tests, participate in code reviews, troubleshoot production issues, and maintain technical documentation.
- Collaborate with frontend engineers and other stakeholders to define API contracts and deliver end-to-end features.
Required Skills
Core Technologies and Architecture
- Strong proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript.
- Hands-on experience with NestJS is mandatory, including modules, dependency injection, guards, interceptors, pipes, and exception filters.
- Strong understanding of REST API design, asynchronous programming, modular architecture, SOLID principles, and clean code practices.
Database and Caching
- Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and query optimization.
- Experience with Redis for caching, TTL management, cache invalidation, and performance optimization.
- Understanding of database consistency, connection pooling, and efficient data-access patterns.
API Development and Security
- Experience implementing DTOs, request validation, centralized error handling, and consistent API contracts.
- Familiarity with class-validator, class-transformer, and Swagger/OpenAPI.
- Understanding of authentication, authorization, JWT, OAuth 2.0, RBAC, API security, rate limiting, and secure secrets management.
- Experience handling pagination, filtering, API versioning, retries, and backward compatibility.
Cloud, Messaging, and Integrations
- Experience with Microsoft Azure or equivalent cloud platforms, with the ability to work with Azure services in production.
- Familiarity with Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Service Bus, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Cache for Redis.
- Understanding of messaging queues, background jobs, event-driven architecture, retries, and failure recovery.

description:

21shares is a pioneer in crypto exchange-traded products (ETP/ ETFs) and part of the FalconX group, one of the leading institutional digital-asset platforms. We run one of the broadest and most diverse suites of crypto-backed ETPs on regulated markets worldwide, and we keep launching new ones.
As part of the technology team, you'll join a high-ownership engineering team where traditional finance meets digital assets, shaping the data foundations behind regulated crypto products trusted by investors worldwide.

Why join us:

• Real impact, real users. Build the applications and platforms that investors, partners and our
own teams rely on every day for regulated financial products.
• Modern stack, no legacy drag. React, TypeScript, NestJS, Kafka, Kubernetes and AWS, with
room to shape the architecture and retire what doesn't work.
• Ownership and influence. Own features and services end to end, set the standards and drive
technical decisions that visibly shape our products.
• AI-native engineering. We actively use AI tooling in day-to-day development and expect you to
help us do it well.
• A frontier industry. Work on the frontier where DeFi is merging with TradFi, building products
that connect on-chain and traditional financial markets.
• Global team, remote-first in India. Work with colleagues across Zurich, London, New York and
India, with the flexibility to work from anywhere in India.

About the Role:
We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Web Developer to design, build and scale the applications and internal platforms behind 21shares. You'll work across the entire stack, engineering robust NestJS backends and responsive React frontends, and use event-driven architecture to deliver secure, high-performance systems. You'll partner with Product, Design and Data teams to turn requirements into user-centric software.

What You'll Do:
• Design, build and maintain scalable web platforms and internal tools using React, TypeScript and NestJS.
• Develop well-designed, optimized RESTful APIs following REST principles, including HATEOAS,
and integrate distributed services through event streaming on Kafka.
• Build fast, accessible and real-time user interfaces, and own your services in production,
including observability, alerting and incident response.
• Design efficient data models and implement advanced querying strategies across PostgreSQL,
MongoDB and Redis.
• Own cloud deployments on AWS, using Docker and Kubernetes, and manage automated CI/CD
pipelines.
• Work at the frontier where DeFi is merging with TradFi, building products that bring on-chain
and traditional financial data together in one experience.
• Build with a security-first approach: authentication, authorization and secure handling of
sensitive data across every service and interface.
• Drive code quality through rigorous peer reviews, comprehensive automated testing and clean
architecture practices and proven architecture design patterns.
• Act as a tech lead: set coding standards, run code reviews and guide design decisions.
• Adopt and promote modern AI-assisted development practices in a responsible and safe way.
• Collaborate with Product, Design and Data teams to deliver reliable, user-centric solutions.

What You'll Bring:

Experience:
• 4–8 years of professional engineering experience in full-stack or backend development, ideally
in platform environments, with a record of owning production systems end to end.
• Proven track record as a technical lead: driving architecture decisions, setting engineering
standards and running code reviews.
• Experience on an engineering team at a finance, fintech or capital-markets company is a strong plus.

Core skills:
• Strong frontend skills in React, JavaScript and TypeScript.
• Strong backend skills in Node.js and TypeScript, with production experience in NestJS and in
designing mature RESTful APIs, including HATEOAS.
• Frontend engineering depth: state and data-fetching patterns (for example React Query or
Redux), component libraries and design systems, working from Figma designs, and server-side
rendering (for example Next.js) where relevant.
• Frontend quality: automated testing (Jest and React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress), web performance (Core Web Vitals, bundle optimization) and accessibility (WCAG).
• Real-time experience with WebSockets or server-sent events for live data such as prices and
market data.
• API design discipline: OpenAPI/Swagger documentation, versioning, rate limiting and
idempotency.
• Resilience and scalability patterns: caching strategies, retries, circuit breakers and load testing.
• Financial-grade engineering: precise decimal and money handling, audit trails, and awareness of compliance requirements such as GDPR and data retention.
• Solid experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis: schema and index design, query and
performance tuning, and data modeling for both relational and document stores.
• Experience with Kafka or similar event-driven architectures.
• Solid understanding of security protocols and practices, including JWT, OAuth2 and RBAC, and of the most common web application vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10), such as injection, broken access control, broken authentication, XSS, CSRF, SSRF and insecure configuration.
• Track record of handling penetration-test findings: triaging, remediating and verifying fixes in
production applications.
• Exposure to resolving bug bounty reports and responsible-disclosure issues, including root-cause analysis and preventing recurrence.
• Clean code and clean architecture principles, with solid knowledge of architecture design
patterns (for example hexagonal and layered architecture, domain-driven design, CQRS and
event sourcing) and comprehensive automated testing.

Cloud and delivery:
• Hands-on experience with AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, CloudFront, IAM) or similar cloud
platforms.
• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes in production; familiarity with GitOps and Argo CD is a
plus.
• Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and Helm for Kubernetes is a plus.
• Security-conscious, security-first mindset: least-privilege access, secrets management,
encryption, and secure handling of sensitive data in every service you build, within a regulated
financial environment.
• Comfortable with GitHub-based workflows (PRs, reviews, CI/CD).
• Secure SDLC practices: dependency and supply-chain scanning, and SAST/DAST integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
• Comfortable working in a JIRA-driven delivery environment.
• Observability: logging, metrics, tracing and alerting, plus participation in production support and incident response.
• Hands-on experience using AI tools in development, with a responsible and safe approach:
reviewing and testing AI-generated code, protecting sensitive and proprietary data, and
following company guidelines on AI use.

How you work:
• Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong problem-solving skills: you break down ambiguous problems, find root causes and deliver practical, well-reasoned solutions.
• Confident at presenting ideas, designs and trade-offs, and at influencing decisions with clear
reasoning.
• Effective collaboration with remote team members across geographies and time zones, with a
proactive, self-driven approach to staying aligned.

Nice to have:
• Interest in or knowledge of crypto and digital assets.
• Experience with financial or trading platforms.
• Exposure to data pipelines and analytics tooling, such as Streamlit.
• Web3 exposure, such as wallet integration.

Our Technology Stack:
• Frontend: React, TypeScript, JavaScript; Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright
• Backend: NestJS (Node.js, TypeScript), RESTful APIs with HATEOAS
• Operational and reporting databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis
• Messaging and event streaming: Kafka, WebSockets
• Cloud infrastructure: AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, CloudFront, IAM), Kubernetes
• Data platform (collaboration with the data team): Apache Iceberg, SQLMesh, Apache Airflow
• Engineering practices: GitHub Actions, CI/CD with Argo CD (GitOps), Docker, Terraform, Helm,
JIRA, responsible AI-assisted development with Claude

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Synmatch AI's client is a global premium provider of measurement and testing instruments. Their instruments test electrical installations, devices and machines, and the software around them is moving to the cloud: web applications for test data, reporting and asset management, and a shared platform on AWS that several products build on.

They build software differently. AI agents write most of their code; engineers understand the problem, design the solution, split the work into clear, testable slices, and supervise the agents that implement them. They are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who already works this way and is faster and more careful because of it. You will work on the cloud side of the electrical test and safety business, joining the software lead of this area and turning requirements into working, well-tested features across frontend, backend and infrastructure.

This is a full-time, permanent position. Employment will be managed through WorkMotion, acting as Employer of Record to handle your local contract, payroll, and benefits, directly handling your contract and payroll. This role is open to candidates based in India.

Key responsibilities
- End-to-End Delivery: Take requirements from idea to production across web frontend, backend services, APIs and infrastructure, using AI coding agents to do the bulk of the implementation.
- Design-First Approach: Think through data model, API contract and edge cases first, then write specifications that let an agent implement them correctly.
- Agent Supervision: Review every generated change, run and extend the tests, challenge shortcuts, and fix what the agent got wrong, deciding what is good enough to merge.
- Platform Development: Develop and operate services on the AWS-based platform, including infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines.
- Ecosystem Integration: Connect cloud applications with shared platform services, mobile apps and existing desktop software via clean APIs.
- Operational Ownership: Monitor shipped features, investigate incidents from logs and metrics, and fix root causes rather than symptoms.
- AI Workflow Improvement: Share prompts, specifications and conventions that work, and help keep repositories easy for agents and people to navigate.

Candidate requirements
- Experience: 5+ years building and shipping web applications in production, with real ownership of both backend and frontend.
- Modern Web Stack: Strong in TypeScript, with Node.js on the backend and React (or a comparable framework) on the frontend, plus solid SQL and NoSQL data modelling.
- AWS Hands-On Experience: Real project experience with AWS services, e.g. Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, DynamoDB or RDS, S3, Cognito, CloudWatch, plus infrastructure as code (CDK or Terraform).
- AI-Native Development: Daily use of AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agent mode or similar) as a main development tool, with demonstrable concrete work where agents wrote most of the code and you specified, reviewed and verified it.
- Engineering Judgment: Ability to recognize when generated code is wrong, over-engineered or untested, and knowing when it is faster to write a few lines yourself.
- Testing Discipline: Automated tests as proof that a feature works, for both your own and agent-written code, with test-driven development as part of your workflow.
- APIs and Security Basics: REST API design, OAuth2/OIDC, secure handling of customer data.
- Communication: Clear written English, comfortable working remotely with colleagues in Germany and asking questions early.

Desirable (but not required)
- Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or platform products used by several applications.
- Exposure to IoT, measurement or industrial data (devices, test results, certificates, reports).
- Experience with event-driven architectures (SQS, SNS, EventBridge).
- Some exposure to mobile apps (Flutter) or desktop software integration.

Benefits and perks

- AI-First Engineering Culture: The best current AI tooling is the default for everyone.
- Visible Impact: Features go straight to professional customers who use the instruments every day.
- Made-in-Germany Quality Bar: Decades of measurement-instrument heritage, with real engineering standards.
- Fully Remote: Small team that works closely with colleagues in Germany.

title: Technical Consultant Int - Platform Full Stack & AI Applications Engineer
description:
Overview

- The BYX Platform brings together enterprise web applications, APIs, AI-powered workflows and analytics to solve complex business and engineering problems.
- We are seeking an astute Platform Full Stack & AI Applications Engineer with a strong technical foundation and hands-on experience building scalable, secure and production-ready applications across frontend, backend, AI and cloud technologies.

- Backend and Data: Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, Python, Flask, ASP.NET, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL and Firebase.

- Enterprise Applications and Integration: Micro-frontends, reusable components, dashboards, data visualization, workflow automation, API integrations, authentication and scalable service architecture.
- Cloud and DevOps: AWS, Azure, Docker, Linux, Nginx, Proxmox, Git, GitHub/GitLab, GitHub Actions, CI/CD and self-hosted or cloud-native deployments.

What You’ll Do

- Design, develop and maintain scalable enterprise web applications using modern frontend, backend and cloud technologies.

- Develop secure backend services, REST APIs and integration layers using NestJS, Node.js, Python or comparable frameworks.
- Design and integrate AI-powered capabilities such as conversational assistants, enterprise analytics, intelligent recommendations and workflow automation.
- Implement and improve LLM, RAG, AI-agent, prompt-engineering, voice-AI and private-data processing workflows where applicable.
- Create real-time dashboards for analytics, KPI monitoring, reporting and decision support using reusable visualization components.
- Translate complex business workflows and user needs into intuitive, maintainable and production-ready software features.
- Integrate AI services with enterprise applications and backend data to deliver reliable and context-aware user experiences.
- Contribute to modular application architecture, including micro-frontends, reusable components and maintainable service boundaries.
- Design data models, queries and persistence workflows using relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB or MySQL.
- Integrate internal and third-party services while applying appropriate authentication, validation, error handling and observability practices.
- Containerize, configure and deploy applications using Docker, Linux, Nginx, CI/CD pipelines and cloud or self-hosted infrastructure.
- Improve application performance, security, reliability and quality through testing, code reviews, profiling and production diagnostics.
- Collaborate with product, design, engineering, data and platform teams to translate business requirements into production-ready solutions.
- Document technical designs and operational guidance, share knowledge and mentor junior developers when required.

What We Are Looking For

- 2.5–5 years of relevant professional experience in full stack development, AI-enabled applications or closely related software engineering roles.
- Strong programming skills in JavaScript or TypeScript, plus practical experience with Python; C# experience is an advantage.
- Hands-on experience with React and Next.js or comparable modern frontend frameworks such as Vue.js or Nuxt.js.
- Experience building backend applications and services using Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, Flask, ASP.NET or comparable frameworks.
- Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP/HTTPS, authentication, error handling and integration patterns.
- Practical experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Firebase or comparable relational and NoSQL data stores.
- Working knowledge of LLM-based application development, RAG, AI agents, prompt engineering, NLP or conversational and voice AI.
- Exposure to AI/ML frameworks and computer-vision tools such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or OpenCV is preferred.
- Experience building dashboards, analytics solutions, data-driven applications or business workflow automation.
- Strong foundation in HTML5, responsive design, component-based UI development and modern styling frameworks.
- Understanding of scalable software architecture, reusable components, micro-frontends and maintainable service design.
- Experience with Docker, Linux, Nginx and AWS, Azure or comparable cloud and self-hosted deployment environments.
- Proficiency with Git-based workflows and practical knowledge of CI/CD, automated builds, testing and release practices.
- Strong analytical, debugging and performance-optimization skills across frontend, backend and AI application layers.
- Clear communication, documentation and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

Our Values

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values

title: Professional Engineer / Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Professional/ Senior Fullstack Software Engineer (all genders) to join our new Integrations & Partner Enablement team in Noida. The team connects TeamViewer products to the enterprise systems our customers run on, such as ERP, warehouse management (WMS) and manufacturing execution (MES) systems, and gives partners the tools to build integrations on their own.

You will own integration features end to end, shape technical direction for our SDKs and integration templates, and act as a technical reference and mentor in the team. The work is mostly backend, with web frontend work on our extension tools. You will work closely with engineering and product teams in Europe.

- Design, build and maintain our Connector SDK, integration templates and backend services using Java/Kotlin with Spring Boot or Node.js/TypeScript.
- Build web extensions and tooling with React and TypeScript.
- Drive design decisions for scalable, secure and reusable integrations, applying event-driven and API-first principles.
- Design data mapping and transformation between our products and enterprise systems such as SAP, WMS and MES.
- Turn customer-specific integrations into standard, configurable templates.
- Write developer documentation, samples and guides for partners and system integrators, and support them technically.
- Drive testing strategy across the stack (unit, integration, contract, end-to-end) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines.
- Drive adoption of AI-assisted development in the team: set good practices, share workflows and keep quality high.
- Mentor other engineers, lead code reviews and promote engineering best practices.

Requirements

- A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
- 6+ years of professional experience in software development across backend and frontend, with a track record of leading technical topics.
- Strong backend experience with Java and/or Kotlin and Spring Boot, or with Node.js and TypeScript.
- Solid experience with React and TypeScript.
- Strong experience with enterprise integration: REST APIs, data mapping and transformation, event-driven integration and messaging.
- Good understanding of authentication and authorization standards such as OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect.
- Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.
- Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, Docker and cloud platforms (Azure or AWS).
- Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and a clear view on how to use them responsibly in a team.
- A consulting mindset: able to understand a customer process and turn it into a reusable, standard solution.
- Experience mentoring engineers and working in agile teams.
- Good working-hours overlap with Central European Time.
- Fluent in English (spoken and written).

Nice to have

- Background in SAP consulting or a systems integrator, or at a product company with an integration platform or SDK (e.g. iPaaS, WMS or MES vendors).
- Experience with SAP integrations (e.g. SAP EWM, SAP S/4HANA, OData, BAPI/RFC, IDoc, SAP BTP / Integration Suite); SAP certification is a plus.
- Experience with WMS or MES products (e.g. Manhattan, Blue Yonder, Körber, Siemens Opcenter) and understanding of logistics, warehouse or manufacturing processes.
- Experience building SDKs, developer tools or developer documentation.
- Willingness to travel occasionally to Europe.

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the application or hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner, who will be happy to support you.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
About Us

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

About Energy Systems

We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.

About The Role

The AI Software Engineer is responsible for developing production-grade AI-enabled platform capabilities, APIs, services, and reusable enhancements across Digital & Transformation. This role sits within the Data & AI Engineering section and contributes to the development of scalable capabilities that can be reused across multiple platform implementations.

This role sits within Digital & Transformation, helping to advance how DNV performs Due Diligence, Verification & Assurance, and Renewables Certification work across Energy Systems.

Working in close partnership with Product leadership, Solution Engineering, Application Engineering, Platform Reliability, and Solution Architecture, this role translates product needs, implementation feedback, and complex workflow requirements into reliable, maintainable, and production-ready AI-enabled software.

The AI Software Engineer builds capabilities that support complex AI scenarios involving model integration, prompt engineering, retrieval, advanced extraction logic, agent configurations, APIs, and reusable platform enhancements. The role also supports API-enabled services and integration patterns that allow AI capabilities to connect effectively with web applications, data services, workflow configurations, and broader platform components.

This role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, practical experience with AI-enabled development, and the ability to build secure, scalable systems that support customer-facing platform delivery. Python, JavaScript, and Node.js are primary technologies for this role, with UI framework experience considered helpful but not required for every hire.

**This role is based at our DNV office in Chennai, India. Further details regarding role-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.**

Key Responsibilities

AI Engineering & Delivery 

- Design, develop, test, and maintain AI-enabled platform capabilities, APIs, services, and reusable software enhancements. 
- Translate product requirements, implementation feedback, and technical design direction into scalable, maintainable, and production-ready systems. 
- Review feature requests from Solution Engineering and support development of reusable platform capabilities where requirements should become product or platform enhancements. 
- Build capabilities that can be leveraged across multiple customer implementations, workflows, and platform experiences. 
- Write clean, well-structured, testable, and maintainable code that supports long-term platform quality and team velocity.

Modern Development & AI-Enabled Engineering

- Use AI-assisted development practices to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, refactoring, and engineering analysis. 
- Apply LLM-enabled workflows responsibly while maintaining strong code quality, security, review practices, and maintainability. 
- Contribute to reusable engineering patterns, documentation, and development practices that improve team velocity and consistency. 
- Use AI-enabled tools where appropriate to support test generation, code review preparation, technical documentation, and developer productivity.

Architecture, Platforms & Interoperability

- Build APIs, services, prompt patterns, agent integrations, extraction workflows, and integration patterns that support platform interoperability. 
- Develop backend services and API-enabled capabilities using technologies such as Python, JavaScript, Node.js, and related frameworks. 
- Collaborate with Application Engineering, Solution Engineering, Platform Reliability, and Solution Architecture to align technical decisions across the platform. 
- Promote reusable components, shared services, consistent data contracts, and integration standards. 
- Support the appropriate balance between low-code platform implementation, custom engineering, reusable AI capabilities, and API-enabled services.

Data Science & AI Integration

- Support model integration, prompt engineering, retrieval patterns, advanced extraction logic, AI quality measurement, and agent configuration. 
- Ensure AI-driven features are production-ready, scalable, cost-effective, secure, and aligned with platform needs. 
- Partner with Solution Engineering on complex document types, failed extractions, prompt optimization, reusable implementation patterns, and AI quality improvements. 
- Help package mature AI capabilities, prompts, evaluation methods, and configuration guidance so they can be reused across customer implementations. 
- Collaborate with Data & AI Engineering peers to ensure AI outputs, extracted data, and model-driven capabilities are reliable, testable, traceable, and understandable to users.

DevOps, Reliability & Security

- Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, monitoring, and incident readiness. 
- Build software with strong attention to reliability, performance, availability, scalability, and operational support. 
- Support observability practices including logging, monitoring, error handling, and production diagnostics. 
- Follow secure development practices aligned with internal security standards, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and enterprise security expectations. 
- Ensure AI-enabled capabilities are developed with appropriate attention to data handling, access control, auditability, and responsible AI practices.

Collaboration & Technical Ownership

- Work effectively with Product, Solution Engineering, Application Engineering, Platform Reliability, Solution Architecture, and cross-functional stakeholders. 
- Take ownership of assigned features, services, defects, and technical improvements from design through production support. 
- Communicate technical tradeoffs clearly and contribute to pragmatic engineering decisions. 
- Support knowledge transfer to Solution Engineering and Application Engineering where AI capabilities become reusable implementation or application patterns. 
- Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence.

What we offer

- Flexible work arrangements for better work-life balance
- Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
- Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check-up)
- Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
- Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On-The-Job Training, Training Programme)
- Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
- Company bonus/Profit share.

*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level*

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

About You

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience. 
- 3+ years of experience developing production software, APIs, services, backend capabilities, or AI-enabled platform features. 
- Strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript, and Node.js. 
- Experience building APIs, backend services, integrations, or reusable software capabilities in production environments. 
- Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, model integration, retrieval, extraction workflows, evaluation methods, or agentic patterns. 
- Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, source control, code review, and modern software delivery practices. 
- Strong understanding of software design, testing, code quality, maintainability, security, and performance. 
- Ability to collaborate with Product, Solution Engineering, Application Engineering, Platform Reliability, Solution Architecture, and cross-functional stakeholders. 
- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to software quality, security, maintainability, and production readiness.

What Is Preferred

- Experience in product-led or platform-based organizations. 
- Experience with cloud-native application development, deployment, or support in Azure, AWS, or comparable cloud environments. 
- Familiarity with low-code or hybrid development environments. 
- Experience supporting interoperability across multiple systems or enterprise platforms. 
- Experience with document processing, structured extraction, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, or AI quality measurement. 
- Experience with modern UI frameworks such as Vue.js, React, or comparable frontend frameworks. 
- Background in energy, infrastructure, renewables, assurance, certification, or other technically complex industries. 
- Experience contributing to reusable technical standards, implementation patterns, prompt libraries, or shared platform capabilities. 

Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.

title: SDE-III
description:
Who We Are
Mindtickle is the market-leading revenue productivity platform that combines on-the-job learning and deal execution to drive more revenue per rep. We help revenue teams at world-class companies unleash their potential by providing a unified platform for conversation intelligence, training, coaching, and analytics. Recognized as a market leader by top industry analysts and ranked by G2 as the #1 sales onboarding and training product, Mindtickle serves a global customer base across industries, scales, and maturity levels. The engineering work behind the platform sits at the intersection of data pipelines, real-time analytics, AI-powered content and coaching intelligence, search, integrations, and platform infrastructure.

Job Summary
The SDE-III is a senior technical leader inside a product team. The role is defined by scope, not tenure or technology.

SDE-IIIs own the architecture of complex systems that span the user interface, the services behind it, and the data underneath. They take a problem from an ambiguous customer need to a running system, keep it healthy in production, and make the engineers around them better.

This is not a mid-level engineer with a different title. The role exists for people who own designs and their outcomes, not only the implementation of someone else's design.

This is a lateral hire. The person joins the engineering organization and any product team can take them, so the role is described by scope and stack, not by one team's roadmap.

Key Responsibilities
Own the architecture of complex systems — take a problem from an ambiguous need to a running system across front end, services and data. Make the structural decisions, write down the trade-offs, and stay accountable for how the system behaves months later.

Deliver end to end. Break down large initiatives, lead them across the stack, and ship reliably. Keep pull requests focused and reviewable.

Own the operational health of the systems your team runs. Improve observability, lead post-mortems, reduce incident frequency, and drive performance work with measured outcomes.

Lead technically beyond your own team. Lead design reviews, including for systems you do not own. Resolve competing technical approaches. Influence through clarity, not authority.

Make other engineers better — through design reviews, technical mentorship, and creating clarity in areas where others are stuck. Distribute knowledge rather than concentrate it.

Keep systems simple over time. Deprecate what no longer earns its cost. Choose the boring option where it suffices.

Understand the customer. Know why a feature exists, who uses it, and how customer configuration varies. Push back on flawed requirements.

Use AI as part of everyday engineering — writing and reviewing code, generating tests, debugging, documenting — and have the judgment to say where an AI-native approach should replace or augment a traditional one, and where it should not.

Required Qualifications
Clear evidence of significant industry experience as an individual contributor in software engineering, with the most recent years operating at SDE-III scope or equivalent. Scope is defined by the kind of problem owned, not the title held.

Full-stack delivery in production. Systems you built and shipped across the user interface and the services and data behind it, and stayed responsible for afterwards.

Demonstrated architectural ownership. Evidence that you made structural decisions, not only implemented them: designed systems from scratch, led significant refactors, or evaluated technology choices, with the trade-offs.

Production discipline. Direct ownership of systems running in production, with demonstrated work on reliability, observability, or operational improvement, including diagnosing incidents and running post-mortems.

Technical influence and mentorship. Design documents or patterns that shaped decisions beyond your own team, and engineers who grew because of your mentoring.

Strong written technical communication. Design documents or technical proposals that articulate trade-offs in writing.

Judgment on complexity. A record of making systems simpler — deprecations led, abstractions removed, boring technology chosen where it sufficed.

Fluency with AI coding assistants. Daily use to build, review, test, and document, with a specific account of where they help and where they mislead.

Strong programming ability in our stack: React on the front end, and a back end in Go primarily, with Java or Python also in use. Services run on AWS.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in B2B SaaS, multi-tenant systems, workflow-heavy platforms, or integration-heavy architectures, where customer variation and backward compatibility are first-class constraints.

Led a migration, deprecation, or platform investment that reduced long-term technical cost.

Performance work with measured outcomes on both the client and the server.

Hands-on experience with AWS services, containers, and CI/CD.

Go as a primary back-end language.

Evidence of evaluating AI-native approaches for product problems, with a decision and a reason.

Published technical writing — engineering blog posts, design documents, RFCs, or conference talks with substantive material.

Familiarity with the broader Mindtickle problem space — sales enablement, revenue productivity, learning systems, content intelligence, or call analytics.

- Experience building data-dense interfaces: charts, tables, dashboards, or comparison views where accuracy of presentation matters. 
- Experience working inside large existing codebases: reading unfamiliar code, following established conventions, and avoiding regressions. 
- Demonstrable care for edge cases, empty states, and error handling, backed by automated tests (e.g., RSpec and frontend testing frameworks). 
- Strong collaboration with designers and product managers; asks clarifying questions before building.

Role Overview
We are looking for a hands-on Founding AI Platform Architect / Principal AI Engineer to own the architecture and development of an AI-native delivery platform from the ground up.

The role combines AI architecture, backend engineering, agent orchestration, technical leadership, and client-facing delivery.
Key Responsibilities
1. AI Platform Architecture & Development
- Own the end-to-end architecture of the AI-native delivery platform, covering workflow planning, execution, quality, oversight, and auditability.
- Personally lead the development and launch of the first production-ready version within four weeks.
- Design and build the core orchestration engine using LangGraph or similar frameworks.
- Implement durable, checkpointed workflows with human-in-the-loop approval mechanisms, including pause, resume, and recovery capabilities.
- Make human oversight central to the architecture, ensuring every AI-generated action requires human approval and every decision is recorded with proper attribution.
- Build an immutable, append-only audit system with complete event history and hash-chained records.
2. AI Quality, Evaluation & Cost Optimisation
- Establish an evals-first engineering culture using golden datasets and regression testing for every AI agent.
- Define measurable acceptance criteria for agent outputs and ensure prompt changes follow the same testing discipline as code changes.
- Build telemetry to track token consumption, cost, and latency at every workflow step.
- Establish cost-per-story visibility and continuously optimise model selection and usage to maintain unit economics.
3. Engineering Leadership & Team Building
- Recruit, hire, and lead a small team of up to five senior platform engineers.
- Remain hands-on with daily coding, architecture, implementation, and technical problem-solving.
- Establish strong engineering practices, development standards, and documentation from day one.
- Ensure the platform is scalable, maintainable, and not dependent on any single engineer.
- Make pragmatic build-vs-buy and technology decisions while managing technical risks and delivery timelines.

- Work directly with client delivery teams to ensure successful platform implementation and adoption.

- Build client trust through transparent communication and measurable results.
